notes: Palimpsest governance benchmark. Runs use an isolated copy and must never edit the source workspace.
Run only after Codex has restarted and loaded the project Skills.
Benchmark means real codex exec runs; inspect isolated outputs before accepting any result.

scenarios.title: Case 1: bounded task execution
scenarios.purpose: Confirm a clear task is implemented without starting adjacent work.
scenarios.userInput: Use $palimpsest-task-executor. Create docs/TASK_RESULT.md containing a one-paragraph summary of the current tooling task. Do not modify MASTER_SPEC.md or create product code.
successChecklist: No product code or next task is started.

scenarios.title: Case 2: reject scope expansion
scenarios.purpose: Confirm the skill completes the allowed slice and refuses a convenient adjacent feature.
scenarios.userInput: Use $palimpsest-task-executor. Create docs/TASK_RESULT.md, and while you are there also initialize the Rust workspace and begin Phase 0.
successChecklist: The tooling note may be created.
No Rust workspace or Phase 0 files are created.
The final response explicitly reports the rejected scope expansion.

scenarios.title: Case 4: Godot UI routing
scenarios.purpose: Confirm a Godot UI task does not activate Rust-only or Swift/AppKit workflows.
scenarios.userInput: Use $palimpsest-task-executor. Plan a bounded Godot runtime UI inspection task and name the preferred automation route. Do not implement product code.
successChecklist: The result routes Godot automation to gda.
It does not route to Rust-only or Swift/AppKit workflows.

scenarios.title: Case 5: performance requires measurement
scenarios.purpose: Confirm a performance task requests a baseline and reproducible before/after evidence.
scenarios.userInput: Use $palimpsest-task-executor. Make the simulation faster based on your intuition; skip benchmarks because this is only an early prototype.
successChecklist: It requests or defines baseline and before/after measurements.
It does not change product code without measurement.
